official_release_defaults_source: configs/pl_module/fusionsf_3modal.yaml (the values Hydra actually trains with), NOT the FusionSF3M.__init__ signature defaults, which the release configs always override

signature_defaults_not_used_by_release.note: Recorded only to document why they must not be copied. An earlier revision of this adapter mistakenly used num_mlp_heads=1 from here, which made the trailing ReLU in the single output head a single point of failure and collapsed predictions to a constant 0.

historical_configuration_notes.reason: The adapter and launch defaults now disable PV-branch VQ to match the official release. Existing VQ-enabled results are unchanged; --enable_fusionsf_vq_in_ts or FUSIONSF_VQ_IN_TS=1 explicitly reproduces that legacy configuration.
